about_the_game:
MIndblitz isn't just a game—it's a gym for your brain. Dive into a sleek, high-speed world of puzzles that will sharpen your logic, test your memory, and push your mental math to the limit. Whether you're a math whiz or just looking to get smarter while having fun, Mindblitz offers an addictive challenge that grows with you.

The Games

Guessbit

Can you find the hidden number? Use logic and speed to narrow down the range. It starts simple, but with modes like Symmetry and Random Negative, you'll need to think fast and trust your gut.

Membit

How much can you hold in your head? From simple Phone Numbers to complex Hexadecimal Codes and Binary Strings, Membit trains your brain to absorb and recall information instantly.

Solvebit

Race against the clock to solve equations. It’s not just arithmetic; it’s Linear Equations, Quadratics, Logarithms, and even Matrix Determinants. Feel the flow as you solve problems faster than you ever thought possible.

Graphbit

Connect the dots between equations and their shapes. Identify Linear, Quadratic, and Trigonometric functions just by looking at their graphs. It’s a visual workout for your analytical mind.

Seriesbit

What comes next? From Fibonacci sequences to Primes and Powers of Two, train your brain to recognize patterns instantly. It’s satisfying, fast-paced, and incredibly rewarding.

Calcubit

Take on the ultimate challenge with Derivatives and Integrals. Perfect for students or anyone who wants to brush up on their calculus skills in a gamified.

Matrixbit

Perform complex operations like Matrix Multiplication, Transposition, and Rotation under pressure. It’s a hardcore mental workout that makes you feel like a human computer.

Why Play Mathbits?

  • 50+ Unique Game Modes: Never get bored with a massive variety of challenges.

  • Track Your Growth: Detailed statistics show exactly how much faster and sharper you’re getting.

  • Compete & Climb: Challenge your friends and top the global leaderboards.

  • Customize Your Challenge: Spice things up with modifiers like Time Attack or the chaotic LSD mode.

Ready to prove your skills? Get Mathbits today and start your mental training!
